This year’s sessions have focused on educating teachers about artificial intelligence and semiconductor technology. Three sessions were held in the United States and one session was held in Egypt. In all, 54 educators learned about the engineering design process this year. They received an overview of TryEngineering resources including the Making of a Microchip and Train Your Tree lesson plans. Workshops are scheduled later this year
